Careers

Seeing Beyond the Visible

At TriEye, we improve and save lives by making Short-Wave Infrared (SWIR) technology accessible to everyone. We harness the power of SWIR to provide superior vision that enables mission-critical image data even in the most challenging visibility conditions.

Our team is composed of world-class experts in device physics, analog, VLSI, photonics, and electro-optics, working together to revolutionize machine vision capabilities. The strength of our team stems from its multidisciplinary and collaborative environment.

We’re looking for passionate team players who want to make a difference - Join our ride as we continue to grow our team, expand our partnerships, and extend our impact across multiple global industries.

Our Values

Boldness

We are a company of inventors and thought leaders. We design, build, and sell cutting-edge technology that’s the first of its kind

Teamwork

We’re here to collaborate and win as a team. We never stop learning and constantly strive for self-improvement

Impact

Our passionate team consists of experts from a variety of fields who are all striving toward the same goals of reshaping machine vision capabilities and saving lives
